title: The clock guard checks a time passed as a script argument, not only one written in the command text
why: Triage wrote step times 1 to 2 minutes ahead of the clock (07:38 and 07:40 CST Nov 12) by passing the time as an argument to a scratchpad script; the guard message-time-matches-clock reads only times written inline, so it did not refuse.
note: A real slip, so a step. First check whether an argument shaped like an ISO time can be read without false alarms on test fixtures.
